Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.desc: Sutradara asal Jepang, Inoue Umetsugu, menyuguhkan dunia gemerlap dari para penghibur di klub malam dalam sebuah kisah tentang perjuangan dua kakak beradik yang diperankan oleh Irene Chen Yi Ling dan Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda bertekad untuk mempersatukan kakak beradik yang tengah berseteru, guna mengalahkan sekelompok pembunuh yang telah menghabisi nyawa ayah mereka.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: Perils Of Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri merekayasa upaya pembunuhan terhadap seorang pangeran, untuk menyamar di 'Desa Hantu', tempat tersembunyi di mana para penjahat buronan bersembunyi. Sesampainya di sana, ia mulai menyelidiki pemimpin mereka yang penuh rahasia.

programme.title: The Mirror And The Lichee
programme.desc: Judul yang menarik tentang dua tiang penyangga yang menandakan memulai kebahagiaan yang berakhir dengan kisah cinta yang tragis antara pria terpelajar dan seorang gadis cantik.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Wang Yu muda menyaksikan pembunuhan brutal guru kung fu-nya yang dilakukan oleh penjahat kejam Yuen Wah. Yu berhasil lolos, namun sang pembunuh sempat melihat elang besar yang tergambar di dada Yu.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Kuo jatuh cinta pada Gadis Naga saat tengah mempelajari seni permainan pedang. Namun, mereka tidak bisa menikah karena jalinan cinta antara guru dan murid adalah suatu hal yang terlarang.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: Setelah Revolusi Tiongkok, penjajah Jepang mulai menyusup ke Timur Laut Tiongkok. Dalam film ini, Arashi Tani, seorang ahli judo yang jahat, ingin membuktikan bahwa orang-orang Tiongkok adalah bangsa Asia yang lemah.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle mengisahkan seorang instruktur bela diri yang dipenjara setelah sebuah insiden fatal. Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Saat seorang pria meninggalkan istri dan putrinya, serangkaian percakapan singkat, gerakan yang diamati, pertemuan tak sengaja, dan tindakan impulsif, menceritakan kisah hubungan yang gagal dan berkembang setelah keputusan ini.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang wanita berusia akhir dua puluhan yang menemukan kembali bakatnya dalam bertinju setelah lama absen. Secara tak terduga, ia bertemu dengan mantan pelatih tinjunya dan keduanya bekerja sama untuk membantunya mencapai babak final pertandingan tinju profesional.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri miskin, Shui dan Ti, berusaha membangun kehidupan mereka sendiri. Dan melalui kerja keras mereka berdua, Shui menjadi seorang eksekutif pemasaran, kemudian sikapnya mulai berubah.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: Rencana penguburan ulang seorang tetua kota berubah menjadi bencana ketika jenazah tersebut bangkit kembali menjadi vampir haus darah yang melompat-lompat, mengincar semua orang yang bertanggung jawab menggali kuburan tersebut. Seorang Pendeta Tao dan dua muridnya berusaha menghentikan teror tersebut.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: Seorang polisi mengandalkan seorang pencuri mobil muda untuk menangkap empat gangster yang berencana merampok seorang pedagang kaya untuk mendapatkan sejumlah besar uang.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah menarik tentang kerumitan dalam menciptakan anak, yang menampilkan penampilan komedi langka oleh Alex Man Chi Leung.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Seorang pria muda yang pemalu dan pekerja kantoran, bertemu dengan seorang wanita cantik dan ambisius yang sedang mengejar karirnya, serta seorang pria lain yang ramah namun penuh rahasia. Pertemuan ini membawa mereka ke dalam perjalanan emosional yang kompleks, penuh dengan kebingungan, kesalahpahaman, dan penemuan diri.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: Kisah tentang pengalaman imigran ilegal dari Tiongkok daratan yang berhasil sampai ke Hong Kong untuk kehidupan yang lebih baik.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Seorang imigran Tionghoa sederhana melancarkan perang berbahaya melawan salah satu organisasi kriminal paling kuat di planet ini.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: Putra dari keluarga kaya jatuh cinta pada seorang wanita yang hanya akan menikahinya setelah ia menjadi seorang Guru Kung-Fu. Dalam 'Drama Komedi' ini, ia menjadi pahlawan legendaris dengan berusaha menyelamatkan kaisar, dalam pencarian cintanya yang sebenarnya.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Seorang aktor berusaha meyakinkan sesosok wanita untuk berperan sebagai Samantha dalam film Bewitched yang dibuat ulang. Namun, ia tidak menyadari bila wanita itu ternyata benar-benar seorang penyihir!

programme.title: Look For A Star
programme.desc: Terinspirasi oleh hubungan antara Stanly Ho dan istri keempatnya, Angela, film ini adalah komedi romantis tentang seorang miliarder yang jatuh cinta dengan seorang dealer kasino yang bersemangat.

programme.title: Coventry Rising : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Malaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.? Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.title: Dion Dublin : 1-To-11
programme.desc: Dion Dublin selects his ultimate Premier League 1 to 11 from the outstanding players he played alongside during his career. Along the way, he shares the stories behind his selections, reveals his favourite manager and looks back on his favourite Premier League goal before completing his starting eleven.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: Soaring Seagulls : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton & Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs. Featuring interviews with the key figures behind Brighton's rise, alongside celebrity fans who followed every twist along the way, this documentary charts a remarkable journey of survival, ambition and one of the greatest comebacks in modern football.

programme.title: The Big Interview
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interview with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: Granit Xhaka : PL Stories
programme.desc: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption?stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as success

programme.title: North African Goats With Hassan Kachloul : PL Goats
programme.desc: The first Moroccan to play in the Premier League, Hassan Kachloul celebrates the greatest North African players to grace the competition. From Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and Egypt, Hassan selects his standout contenders before narrowing them down to a final three and crowning his ultimate North African Premier League GOAT

programme.title: Denis Irwin: My Premier League Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Denis Irwin won 7 Premier League titles in his time at Manchester United. Named by Sir Alex Ferguson as "the one certainty to get in the team", Irwin reflects on key games from his outstanding career, including a trip to Old Trafford as an opposition player to face a young Cristiano Ronaldo.

programme.title: Ep05 : The Catch-Up Show

Dipengaruhi oleh tiga pria dengan kepribadian kuat, Aprilia harus menemukan keseimbangan antara kedewasaan dan pilihan yang dibuat oleh hati seorang gadis muda. Saat Natal tiba, kehidupan hanya memberikan hadiah kepada gadis cantik berbakat ini yang cukup kuat untuk diraihnya.

Ia dan istrinya bertemu di sebuah kapal pesiar lebih dari 25 tahun yang lalu, di mana keduanya bekerja sebagai instruktur tari. Mereka jatuh cinta dan menikah, tetapi sementara Andrea ingin menetap di kota kecil asalnya dan mengambil alih studio tari orang tuanya, Tanner berasal dari kota kecil dan ingin bepergian sebelum menetap.

Tidak percaya bahwa putrinya pergi begitu saja, Rachel melakukan penyelidikan sendiri untuk mencari kebenaran. Dalam pencariannya, ia menemukan adanya jaringan eksploitasi dan perdagangan manusia yang mengancam banyak korban. Dengan keberanian dan tekad yang kuat, Rachel berusaha menyelamatkan putrinya sebelum semuanya terlambat.

Masalahnya Maura bingung gimana caranya deketin cowok, ngobrol sama cowok jelek aja dia grogi apalagi sama cowok cakep. Alhasil setiap Arsena (Fattah Syah) dateng kerumahnya, karena grogi Maura selalu pasang tampang jutek. Arsena ajakin Maura ngobrol. Saking gugupnya, Maura malah gelagapan dan ujung-ujungnya Maura pergi begitu aja meninggalkan Arsena.

programme.title: Aku Terlalu Sah Buat Kamu Yang Gelisah
programme.desc: Rangga (Hardi Fadhillah) seorang pria yang gagal move on setelah diputuskan oleh kekasihnya. Ia selalu teringat mantannya. Pada suatu hari, Rangga meminta jasa Rara (Ina Marika) untuk menjadi konsultan jodohnya agar ia bisa melupakan mantannya.

programme.title: Jangan Pinjol Hatiku, Nanti Semakin Berbunga
programme.desc: Karena keluarganya punya hutang, ibunya menyuruh Mita (Jennifer Eve) untuk mencari calon suami kaya agar bisa melunasi hutang keluarganya. Akhirnya ia mendapat calon suami yang tepat, Dirga (Lucky Perdana) yang ternyata anak dari debt collector yang memberi hutang pada kedua orang tuanya.

programme.title: Rumah Angker Kok Malah Bikin Baper
programme.desc: Celin (Shanice Margaretha) nekat kabur dari rumah karena mau dijodohkan oleh orang tuanya. Celin pun pergi dengan temannya. Saat di perjalanan, Celin kesal karena mobilnya harus berhasil dengan mobil pick up yang membawa sayur padahal jalannya sangat kecil dan hanya cukup 1 mobil. Lalu, muncul Dimas (Aditya Zoni) dari balik jendela mobilnya dan menyalahkan Celin hingga Celin kesal dan terlibat perak dengan Dimas. Kemudian, Celin dan temannya sampai di sebuah rumah mewah yang ada di dalam hutan. Celin memutuskan untuk tinggal sementara di rumah yang katanya angker.

SERI INI JUGA MENGEKSPLORASI DINAMIKA ANTARA ASH, PIKACHU, DAN KARAKTER-KARAKTER LAIN YANG MEREKA TEMUI DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA. DENGAN FOKUS PADA PERTUMBUHAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN KEKUATAN TIM, "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" MENYAJIKAN PETUALANGAN YANG SERU DAN PENUH DENGAN KEJUTAN BAGI PARA PENGGEMAR POKEMON.

programme.desc: Katuri adalah sebuah acara menarik tentang empat anak burung pegar yang tumbuh di hutan alami di bawah perawatan dan kasih sayang lembut ibu flora. Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: Pororo The Little Penguin
programme.desc: Pororo The Little Penguin

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es. Mereka semua memiliki kepribadian dan minat yang berbeda, yang terkadang menyebabkan sedikit masalah di dunia musim dingin yang tenang. tetapi selalu bersama-sama, setiap hari adalah petualangan di mana mereka belajar semua pelajaran hidup, baik besar maupun kecil !

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Kenalan yuk sama bing, kelinci kecil yang lucu dan penuh rasa ingin tahu! bersama teman dewasa kesayangannya, flop, bing selalu menemukan hal-hal baru yang seru setiap hari. Dari main gelembung, menali sepatu, sampai mengatasi rasa sedih, semuanya jadi petualangan yang menyenangkan!yuk, ikuti petualangan bing dan teman-temannya! kita bisa belajar banyak hal sambil tertawa, lho!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey adalah serial animasi asal australia yang mengikuti petualangan sehari-hari seekor anak anjing ras blue heeler berusia enam tahun bernama bluey. Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Dancow Indonesia Cerdas
programme.desc: Dancow Indonesia Cerdas

programme.title: DANCOW INDONESIA CERDAS (DANCOW INDONESIA CERDAS S2 EPS 10)
programme.desc: Episode ini menghadirkan tantangan Fun with English!, saat para siswa menjawab soal dari penutur asli bahasa Inggris. Mereka menguji kemampuan berbahasa, kepercayaan diri, dan kerja sama tim melalui kompetisi edukatif yang menyenangkan.

programme.title: Abang L The Explorer
programme.desc: Abang L The Explorer

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer sebuah veriety show yang memberikan hiburan dan edukasi. Dimana abang l akan mengajak penonton bermain sekaligus belajar hal-hal seusia abang l dan berbeda disetiap episodenya. Tingkah lucu, gemas dan keaktifan abang l akan menjadi warna yang menghidupi program ini. Abang l yang pinter berbicara akan bertanya kepada orang di sekitar abang l. abang l juga akan mencoba beberapa profesi yang bertujuan untuk mengedukasi dari setiap peran profesi tersebut.

programme.title: Magic 5 The Animation
programme.desc: Magic 5 The Animation

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION MENCERITAKAN PETUALANGAN LIMA REMAJA ISTIMEWA—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, DAN IRSHAD—YANG DITEMUKAN DAN DIASUH OLEH FATHIR.KELIMA ANAK INI MEMILIKI KEKUATAN SUPER YANG UNIK DAN BERBEDA. MEREKA MENGGUNAKAN KEKUATAN TERSEBUT UNTUK MEMECAHKAN BERBAGAI KASUS DAN MASALAH YANG TERJADI DI SEKITAR MEREKA. SELAIN MISI PENYELAMATAN, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI KONFLIK SEHARI-HARI DI SEKOLAH, TERUTAMA DARI GENG MUSUH MEREKA, THE BEAST. ANIMASI INI BERFOKUS PADA KISAH PERSAHABATAN, KEKOMPAKAN, DAN PENGGUNAAN KEKUATAN SUPER UNTUK KEBAIKAN.

programme.title: New Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: New Keluarga Somat

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: IKUTI PETUALANGAN SERU KELUARGA PAK SOMAT SAAT MEMULAI HIDUP BARU DI CITEKO! DARI MEMBANGUN WARUNG IMPIAN BU INAH, KEHEBOHAN BERTETANGGA DENGAN CEU KOKOM, HINGGA PERJUANGAN PAK SOMAT MENJADI OJEK ONLINE DEMI KELUARGA. KISAH HANGAT PENUH TAWA DAN PESAN MORAL YANG COCOK UNTUK SEMUA UMUR.

programme.title: Kartun Favorit Katuri
programme.desc: Kartun Favorit Katuri

programme.title: KARTUN FAVORIT KATURI
programme.desc: KATURI ADALAH SEBUAH ACARA MENARIK TENTANG EMPAT ANAK BURUNG PEGAR YANG TUMBUH DI HUTAN ALAMI DI BAWAH PERAWATAN DAN KASIH SAYANG LEMBUT IBU FLORA. IBU FLORA SELALU MENDORONG ANAK-ANAKNYA UNTUK MENJELAJAHI DUNIA BERSAMA HEWAN LAIN DAN MEMBANTU MEREKA KAPAN PUN MEREKA MEMBUTUHKAN. KETIKA ANAK-ANAK BURUNG MERAK MENGALAMI KESULITAN ATAU BAHKAN BAHAYA, IBU FLORA SELALU ADA UNTUK MENJAGA MEREKA TETAP AMAN.

programme.title: Bioskop Keluarga Indonesia
programme.desc: Bioskop Keluarga Indonesia

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (GO! TAYO & TEAM PENYELAMAT MISI PENYELAMATAN VR)
programme.desc: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA ADALAH PROGRAM TELEVISI ANAK YANG MENAWARKAN PILIHAN TONTONAN SERU DAN MENDIDIK BAGI SELURUH KELUARGA. DENGAN MENAMPILKAN FILM-FILM ANIMASI YANG MENGHIBUR DAN CERITA-CERITA MENARIK, ACARA INI MEMPERSEMBAHKAN PETUALANGAN-PETUALANGAN YANG LUCU DAN PENUH PESAN MORAL YANG BISA DINIKMATI BERSAMA. PROGRAM INI MENJADI MOMEN BERHARGA BAGI KELUARGA INDONESIA UNTUK BERSATU DAN MENIKMATI WAKTU BERSAMA DALAM KESERUAN YANG TAK TERLUPAKAN.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 24: MASTER JOURNEYS
programme.desc: "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH SALAH SATU SERI TERBARU DALAM FRANCHISE POKEMON YANG MELANJUTKAN PERJALANAN ASH KETCHUM SEBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON. SERI INI MENAMPILKAN PETUALANGAN ASH BERSAMA DENGAN TEMANNYA, PIKACHU, DALAM MENJELAJAHI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON YANG BERBEDA. MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN BERBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON BARU, MENANTANG GYM LEADERS, DAN MENGHADAPI TIM ROCKET YANG SELALU INGIN MENCURI POKEMON. SALAH SATU FOKUS UTAMA DARI "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH PENJELAJAHAN DUNIA POKEMON YANG LUAS. ASH DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA BERTUJUAN UNTUK MENGHADIRI WORLD CORONATION SERIES, SEBUAH KOMPETISI BESAR DI MANA MEREKA BERUSAHA UNTUK MENJADI JUARA POKEMON MASTER. DI SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN POKEMON LEGENDARIS, MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN BARU, DAN BELAJAR LEBIH BANYAK TENTANG DUNIA POKEMON. SERI INI JUGA MENGEKSPLORASI DINAMIKA ANTARA ASH, PIKACHU, DAN KARAKTER-KARAKTER LAIN YANG MEREKA TEMUI DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA. DENGAN FOKUS PADA PERTUMBUHAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN KEKUATAN TIM, "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" MENYAJIKAN PETUALANGAN YANG SERU DAN PENUH DENGAN KEJUTAN BAGI PARA PENGGEMAR POKEMON.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

programme.desc: Mommy Says adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang dipandu oleh Lin Shu-wei. Setiap episode membahas berbagai topik yang dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari, mulai dari perawatan kecantikan, tren busana, kesehatan, parenting, hingga tips menjadi konsumen yang cerdas. programme.title: Girls Tease

Dipandu oleh Tien Hsin dan Fabien Yang, setiap episode menghadirkan selebritas, pakar, serta perwakilan masyarakat untuk berbagi pengalaman dan berdiskusi mengenai tren kecantikan, fashion, percintaan, karier, kesehatan, hingga berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perempuan urban. Dikemas dengan suasana santai, interaktif, dan penuh humor, acara ini menyuguhkan informasi sekaligus hiburan yang relevan bagi penonton modern.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: Top Singers menghadirkan para penyanyi berbakat yang menunjukkan kemampuan vokal dan gaya musik mereka melalui berbagai penampilan menarik. Setiap episode menampilkan interpretasi lagu-lagu populer, kisah perjalanan musik para penyanyi, serta momen spesial yang memperlihatkan bakat dan karakter unik masing-masing artis. Program ini menjadi wadah apresiasi bagi para musisi dan pecinta musik.

programme.title: Love Now
programme.desc: Love Now mengisahkan Yang Yi Ru, seorang eksekutif periklanan yang terlalu fokus pada pekerjaannya hingga membuat keluarga dan sahabatnya khawatir. Demi memaksanya beristirahat, mereka membuatnya percaya bahwa usianya tidak akan lama lagi. Dalam perjalanan yang dijalaninya, Yi Ru bertemu Lan Shi De dan perlahan menjalin hubungan yang penuh kehangatan. Di tengah berbagai kesalahpahaman, konflik keluarga, dan tantangan hidup, keduanya belajar tentang arti cinta, kepercayaan, dan pentingnya menghargai setiap momen dalam kehidupan.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World menghadirkan laporan mendalam mengenai berbagai peristiwa internasional, mulai dari politik, ekonomi, teknologi, budaya, hingga isu sosial yang berkembang di berbagai belahan dunia. programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player mengisahkan Pun yang kembali ke Thailand setelah tunangannya melarikan diri membawa seluruh tabungannya. Dalam upaya mencari pelaku, ia mendekati Ploy, seorang aktris ternama yang juga merupakan adik sang buronan. Pencarian tersebut perlahan membuka berbagai rahasia, kebohongan, dan konspirasi yang tidak pernah mereka duga. Di tengah konflik yang semakin rumit, hubungan keduanya berkembang menjadi kisah yang menguji kepercayaan, keberanian, dan arti cinta yang sesungguhnya.

programme.title: Flavor Of Life
programme.desc: Di usia 40 tahun, Han Xiao meninggalkan pekerjaan impiannya dan membuka kembali kedai milik orang tuanya. Kepulangan sang ayah yang mengidap demensia memaksa keluarga menghadapi luka lama dan belajar memulai kembali.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa merupakan program budaya dan perjalanan yang memperkenalkan keindahan tradisi rakyat Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi kuil-kuil bersejarah, perayaan keagamaan, dan komunitas lokal untuk mengungkap kisah para dewa, adat istiadat, kerajinan tradisional, hingga kuliner khas daerah. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan menghibur, acara ini tidak hanya memperkenalkan destinasi wisata, tetapi juga melestarikan nilai-nilai budaya serta warisan spiritual yang menjadi bagian penting dari identitas masyarakat Taiwan.

programme.desc: Setiap episode menghadirkan eksplorasi mendalam yang penuh tantangan, sekaligus memperluas wawasan tentang kehidupan dan lingkungan global.

programme.title: Mancing Mania Strike Back
programme.desc: Sebuah acara Memancing yang akan mengajak Sobat Angler Indonesia untuk mengeksplor spot-spot memancing di wilayah Nusantara dengan pemandangan yang eksotis. Mancing Mania Strike Back juga akan memberikan informasi dan edukasi tentang keanekaragaman hayati serta ekosistem perairan.

programme.title: Redaksi Pagi Akhir Pekan
programme.desc: Sebuah program news bulletin yang hadir di akhir pekan setiap pagi hari untuk memberikan update terkini tentang berbagai peristiwa baik di tanah air maupun mancanegara. Juga menghadirkan feature ringan sebagai penambah khazanah informasi bagi pemirsa TRANS7.

programme.title: Cuan Bos
programme.desc: Program yang menyajikan sebuah tayangan yang bercerita tentang orang-orang terkemuka dalam menjalankan bisnisnya. Selain itu, program ini juga akan membahas mengenai profesi ataupun pekerjaan yang terlihat sepele oleh kebanyakan orang namun bisa menjadi peluang emas dan menghasilkan keuntungan yang luar biasa jika ditekuni.

programme.title: Makan Receh
programme.desc: Program makan enak bisa dimana saja dengan varian menu yang receh tapi rasa gak recehan.

programme.title: Selebrita On The Weekend
programme.desc: Program infotaiment yang hadir di akhir pekan untuk menyajikan informasi terkini dari dunia Selebritis. Dengan angle yang tajam dan materi esklusif yang dimiliki, Selebrita mampu memberikan informasi seputar Selebritis yang tidak dimiliki oleh infotainment lain.

programme.title: Legenda Bertuah
programme.desc: Legenda Bertuah akan menceritakan kisah legenda nusantara dengan sentuhan teknologi kecerdasan buatan.

programme.title: Secret Story
programme.desc: Program sejarah yang mengangkat fakta-fakta tersembunyi dalam sejarah Indonesia. Kisah Legenda, misteri, tokoh, peristiwa, asal-usul disingkap disini

programme.title: POV (Pasti Obrolan Viral)
programme.desc: Program acara yang membahas isu terkini seputar selebriti, mulai dari gosip hingga mengupas lebih dalam dengan mencari sisi lain dari berbagai narasumber.

programme.title: Arisan
programme.desc: Game show komedi yang dipandu oleh Surya Insomnia, mempertemukan tiga tim yang masing-masing terdiri dari enam orang, dari kalangan selebritas dan peserta yang mayoritas berasal dari kalangan ibu-ibu/wanita untuk mengikuti berbagai kuis dan permainan hiburan dan berkesempatan memenangkan hadiah menarik.

programme.title: BTS

programme.title: The Police
programme.desc: Program acara realitas yang bekerja sama dengan Kepolisian Negara Republik Indonesia untuk mengikuti aksi dan kegiatan kepolisian dalam menjaga keamanan, menangkap pelaku kejahatan, serta memberikan teladan bagi masyarakat.

programme.title: Website Tengah Malam
programme.desc: sebuah kampus yang diteror oleh sebuah website tersebut muncul tiba-tiba, hanya mahasiswa tertentu yang dapat mengaksesnya, website itu perantara untuk membalaskan dendam, ketika mahasiswa tersebut emasukkan nama seseorang di kolom finder. maka keesokkan harinya orang yang ditulis dikolom finder tersebut akan hilang lenyap begitu saja dan mati.

programme.title: Superbike 2026
programme.desc: Kejuaraan Dunia Superbike 2026 merupakan musim ke-39 dari Kejuaraan Dunia Superbike. Ini adalah musim pertama dalam 13 tahun yang tidak menampilkan Juara Dunia Superbike petahana, karena Toprak Razgatlıoğlu—yang sebelumnya menjuarai kejuaraan pada tahun 2025—akan berkompetisi di MotoGP mulai tahun 2026.

programme.title: Best Fishing

programme.title: Best Fishing

programme.title: Dracin
programme.desc: Drama Cinta yang Tersembunyi (Love Lurking) mengisahkan Gu Nian, seorang dokter bedah yang hidupnya berubah drastis setelah menyelamatkan seorang narapidana kasus narkoba bernama K. Tanpa disadari, ia terseret ke dalam dunia gelap kartel kriminal. Awalnya bekerja sama sebagai rekan, hubungan Gu Nian dan K perlahan berkembang menjadi cinta yang rumit di tengah situasi berbahaya. Saat ancaman semakin nyata, K rela mempertaruhkan nyawanya untuk melindungi Gu Nian dari bos kartel, Peng Li.

programme.desc: Jad et ses soeurs mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari Jad bersama dua saudara kembarnya, Ranya dan Syrine. Dalam setiap episode, mereka menghadapi berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan dunia anak-anak, mulai dari kegiatan sekolah, permainan bersama teman, perjalanan keluarga, hingga tantangan kecil yang mengajarkan nilai-nilai kehidupan. programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

Yum Jung Ah, Kim Sun Young, Kang You Seok, dan Roh Yoon Seo menjelajahi laut, ladang, serta sungai untuk memanen bahan-bahan segar sesuai musim, lalu mengolah hasil kerja keras mereka menjadi hidangan lezat.

programme.title: GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria, Ep 4

programme.title: Walking Through Village, Ep 7

programme.title: You Can Cook, Sam Kim, Ep 15

programme.title: The Moon

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: Willow (Cambrie Schroder), a determined young teenager, is obsessed with the idea of meeting the father she never knew. She leaves her cushy life in Malibu to travel to the Sierra Nevada mountains, where she pays a surprise visit to Jack (Ricky Schroder), a rugged cowboy who has no idea he’s a father. As the two struggle to bond, Willow makes a connection with a wild mustang, Bravo. Jack wants to capture and tame the magnificent horse, but Willow is convinced he needs to be free. Will the wild stallion that brought them together end up tearing them apart?

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: The Heart Of Me [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Set in 1930s London with two sisters, Madeleine married to Rickie, and Dinah, who falls in love with him.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

programme.title: Chick Fight

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: In a future beset by chaos and violence, mercenary Gibson Rickenbacker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is charged with a mission that could change everything: protecting beautiful cyborg Pearl Prophet (Dayle Haddon). She holds the cure for a deadly disease that could destroy humanity, and must get it to scientists in Atlanta. But warlord Tremolo Fender (Vincent Klyn), fearing that his power will be undercut by peace, intends to make sure she never reaches her destination.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Six Degrees of Separation
programme.desc: Privileged art dealers Flan (Donald Sutherland) and Ouisa (Stockard Channing) are hosting a dinner party when Paul (Will Smith), a blood-soaked young man, arrives on their doorstep. He claims to be a friend of their Ivy League children, and charms his way into the house. But when the couple discovers the truth about Paul and his real identity, they kick him out. As the couple trades stories with their friends about Paul, his presence proves surprisingly hard to shake.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: In 1892 Lizzie Borden lives a quiet life in Massachusetts under the strict rules established by her father. Lizzie finds a kindred spirit in the live-in maid, Bridget, and friendship soon blossoms into a secret romance. But tension mounts in the Borden household, leading to a violent breaking point.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: As a young boy, Tim (Aaron Murphy) witnesses the horrifying event of his father (Charles Mesure) being dragged away by the boogeyman. Despite the reassurances of his mother (Lucy Lawless) that the boogeyman is not real, he is never the same afterward. Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma.

programme.title: Antisocial
programme.desc: Five university friends gather at a house party to ring in the New Year. Unbeknownst to them, an epidemic has erupted outside, causing outbreaks around the world.

programme.title: The Terror of Hallow's Eve
programme.desc: When a fifteen-year-old is beaten up by high school bullies, his intense yearning for revenge unintentionally summons up evil supernatural forces offering to scare his enemies to actual death.

programme.title: A Christmas Love
programme.desc: Struck by bad luck during the holidays, a struggling couple receives the joyful gift of Christmas love when they discover an old letter that sparks the magic of the season.

programme.title: Stalked by My Doctor: A Sleepwalker's Nightmare
programme.desc: Wanted for multiple crimes, Dr. Albert Beck assumes the identity of another doctor en route to a new job at a sleep clinic. He falls for his first patient, Shelli, who suffers from nocturnal sleep sex.

programme.title: Never Heard
programme.desc: Aaron Davis is accused of murder for a crime he didn't commit. His son Jalen gets entangled with dangerous drug dealers. Will Aaron find a way to prove his innocence and save his son's life before it is too late?

programme.title: Reflections on the Living Dead
programme.desc: Director George A. Romero, co-writer John A. Russo, and producers Russell W. Streiner and Karl Hardman gather for the first time in 25 years for a once-in-a-lifetime roundtable discussion on the making of "Night of the Living Dead."

programme.title: Exegesis Lovecraft
programme.desc: A documentary following a filmmaker as he traces the life of H.P. Lovecraft, from woodland cemeteries in Rhode Island to the docks of New York and the streets of Quebec City. A film that proves that the truth is weirder than fiction.

programme.title: Wildlike
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Mackenzie, a troubled teen, is sent by her mother to live with her uncle in Juneau, Alaska. She runs away and an unlikely friendship forms in the Alaskan wilderness, giving a runaway girl hope and sanctuary in America's last frontier.

programme.title: Sister Cities
programme.desc: When four estranged sisters return to mourn following their mother's alleged suicide, they find a mystery waiting for them. When they discover that their mother's body is still in the tub, they confront Austin, the one daughter who stayed behind. As suspicions grow, hard truths are revealed and their relationships with each other are thrown into turmoil.

programme.title: White Wall
programme.desc: Set in a wasteland ravaged by a virus called the VXII, enclosed by a large white wall, the last survivor from a brutal child internment camp reluctantly joins a bounty hunter to protect the idyllic life he has rebuilt.

programme.title: Flesh Wounds
programme.desc: On a remote US Army facility, a group of scientists conducting top secret weapon experiments, vanish. An elite covert ops team, commanded by Lt. Tyler, is tasked with recovering the missing personnel within 24 hours.

programme.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
programme.desc: For many years, Heather Mason (Adelaide Clemens) and her father, Harry (Sean Bean), have been on the run from dangerous forces she does not understand. Heather continues to be plagued by terrifying nightmares and frightened by her father's disappearance, and on the eve of her 18th birthday, she discovers that she is not who she thinks she is. The revelation leads her deep into the demonic world of Silent Hill, where she may become trapped forever.

programme.title: The Imposter
programme.desc: Filmmaker Bart Layton chronicles the tale of Frederic Bourdin, a con artist who seemingly tricked a Texas family into believing he was a relative who disappeared years earlier.

programme.title: Two Thousand and None
programme.desc: A man finds himself seeing life from a new point when he finds out it's almost over. Before long he starts seeing images of his childhood in Armenia everywhere. His last mission in life is to dig up his parents in Canada and bury them in Armenia, where he believes him and his family belong.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: After Regina Lampert (Audrey Hepburn) falls for the dashing Peter Joshua (Cary Grant) on a skiing holiday in the French Alps, she discovers upon her return to Paris that her husband has been murdered. Soon, she and Peter are giving chase to three of her late husband's World War II cronies, Tex (James Coburn), Scobie (George Kennedy) and Gideon (Ned Glass), who are after a quarter of a million dollars the quartet stole while behind enemy lines. But why does Peter keep changing his name?

programme.title: The Rising Hawk
programme.desc: During the 13th century, a small village fights for freedom in the frontier landscape of the Carpathian Mountains against Mongolian invaders.

programme.title: Bloodfist II
programme.desc: The world kickboxing champion (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) retreats to Manila, lands in a mess and fights his way out.

programme.title: The TV Set
programme.desc: Mike Klein (David Duchovny), the creator of a TV pilot called "The Wexler Chronicles," learns the hard way about how television shows evolve from concept to reality. Though Mike's concept involves serious subject, a network executive (Sigourney Weaver) and her cohorts have other plans to lighten up and dumb down the show to appeal to a broader audience.

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: An Australian trucker (Stacy Keach) picks up a hitchhiking heiress (Jamie Lee Curtis) and the trail of a killer in a green van.

programme.title: The Last Seduction
programme.desc: Looking to escape her unhappy marriage, villainous femme fatale Bridget Gregory (Linda Fiorentino) convinces her husband, Clay (Bill Pullman), to sell cocaine, then steals the profits and runs out on him. She stops in a small town en route to Chicago, where she ensnares her next conquest, insurance man Mike Swale (Peter Berg). After getting a job at his insurance company, Bridget convinces Mike to run a scam -- but things take a deadly turn when she recruits him to help get rid of her husband.

programme.title: Metroland
programme.desc: In late-1970s suburban London, Chris (Christian Bale) and Marion (Emily Watson) have settled into a comfortable yet all-too-predictable middle-class existence. Chris receives an unexpected visit from his free-spirited friend Toni (Lee Ross), a reunion that reminds him of a more carefree time in the 1960s Paris. Now, with lingering doubts about his marriage bubbling up, Chris must make the choice between revisiting his youthful abandon with Toni or facing the here and now with Marion.

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael
programme.desc: Movie star Roxy Carmichael is abandoning the bright lights of Hollywood, Calif. And returning to her small Ohio hometown -- at least long enough to dedicate a city building. And now the whole town of Clyde is bracing for Carmichael's return, most of all her now-married old flame Denton Webb and troubled teen Dinky Bossetti. An orphan with few friends, Dinky is convinced that Carmichael is her birth mother, and that the actress will reclaim her when she returns.

programme.title: The Warrior's Way
programme.desc: Refusing to kill an infant from an enemy clan, master swordsman Yang (Jang Dong-gun) takes the child and flees to an American frontier town. He puts away his sword for good, vowing to raise the baby in peace. Yang befriends Lynne, a woman who wants revenge against a colonel, the man who murdered her family. When the colonel returns to wreak havoc on the town, Yang draws his sword to protect his new friends, but the sound of fighting draws Yang's murderous clansmen into the fray as well.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: For five men (Karl Urban, James Marsden, Wentworth Miller, Eric Stonestreet, Matthias Schoenaerts), the opportunity to share a penthouse in the city -- in which to carry on extramarital affairs -- is a dream come true, until the dead body of an unknown woman turns up. Realizing that her killer must be one of their group, the men are gripped by paranoia as each one suspects another. Friendships are tested, loyalties are questioned, and marriages crumble while fear and suspicion run rampant.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Teenage Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) journeys through a maze to recover her baby brother (Toby Froud) from a goblin king (David Bowie).

programme.title: The Road to Wellville
programme.desc: A staunch advocate of healthy living, Dr. John Harvey Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) opens a sanitarium that promotes his progressive, if eccentric, ideas about optimal well-being. Among the clients who arrive at the facility are the opportunistic Charles Ossining (John Cusack), who is keen on marketing Kellogg's cereal, and the wealthy Will Lightbody (Matthew Broderick) and his wife, Eleanor (Bridget Fonda). This comedy is inspired by an actual spa run by Dr. Kellogg at the turn of the century.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

programme.title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
programme.desc: Pop-culture satires include "Cleopatra Schwartz," "A Fistful of Yen" and "Catholic High-School Girls in Trouble."

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: The Commitments
programme.desc: Jimmy Rabbitte, a self-proclaimed promoter, decides to organize an R&B group to fill the musical void in his hometown of Dublin, Ireland. The band comes together but ends up consisting entirely of white musicians who have little experience with the genre. Even though their raw talent and lofty aspirations gain the group notoriety, the pitfalls of fame begin to tear at their newfound friendships as they prepare for their big show. Based on the novel by Roddy Doyle.

But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

Once there, however, Wendy and her brothers are kidnapped by Captain Hook (Jason Isaacs). Peter, with assistance from the fairy Tink (Ludivine Sagnier), must face Hook in order to rescue the Darlings.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: Evan Almighty
programme.desc: Newscaster Evan Baxter (Steve Carell) leaves Buffalo behind when he wins a seat in Congress. Moving his wife (Lauren Graham) and family to northern Virginia, he seems to have it made, then God (Morgan Freeman) throws a crisis of biblical proportions at his feet: The Lord wants him to build an ark and line up all the animals two-by-two in preparation for a flood.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Brilliant and obese scientist Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) invents a miraculous weight-loss solution. After a date with chemistry student Carla Purty (Jada Pinkett) goes badly, a depressed Klump tries the solution on himself. Though he instantly loses 250 pounds, the side effects include a second personality: an obnoxiously self-assertive braggart who calls himself Buddy Love. Buddy proves to be more popular than Sherman, but his arrogance and bad behavior quickly spiral out of control.

programme.title: Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Professor Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) is getting married. And the Klump family could not be more delighted. His fiancée Denise (Janet Jackson) is thrilled to become a Klump, and with her appetite she'll fit right in. But Buddy Love ... well, Buddy is another matter.

programme.title: Wet Hot American Summer
programme.desc: Set on the last day of camp, in the hot summer of 1981, "Wet Hot American Summer" follows a group of counselors who are each trying to complete their unfinished business before the day ends. The entire summer of pent-up sexual frustrations, unresolved post-traumatic stress, pending separations and of course, the talent show, all weigh heavily on the minds and groins of counselors and campers alike.

programme.title: Out on a Limb
programme.desc: While heading to the town where his sister, Marci (Courtney Peldon), lives, big-city banker Bill Campbell (Matthew Broderick) is robbed by a woman (Heidi Kling) who takes everything he has, including his clothes and a business document worth millions of dollars. Bill eventually reunites with Marci, who is in a tizzy because she thinks their stepfather (Jeffrey Jones) has been killed. While trying to determine if his sister is right, Bill must also get back his valuable paperwork.

programme.title: Dazed and Confused
programme.desc: This coming-of-age film follows the mayhem of a group of rowdy teenagers in Austin, Texas, celebrating the last day of high school in 1976. The graduating class heads for a popular pool hall and joins an impromptu keg party, however star football player Randall Pink Floyd has promised to focus on the championship game and abstain from partying. Meanwhile, the incoming freshmen try to avoid being hazed by the seniors, most notably the sadistic bully Fred O'Bannion.

programme.title: For Richer or Poorer
programme.desc: Brad Sexton (Tim Allen) and his wife, Caroline (Kirstie Alley), are wealthy New Yorkers with both marital and financial problems. The latter issue becomes a pressing matter when they discover that their accountant has embezzled millions and pinned the blame on them. Forced to go on the lam, Brad and Caroline end up in an Amish area of Pennsylvania and decide to pose as members of the religious group to evade the IRS. As the two adapt to the simple Amish lifestyle, they begin to reconnect.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Eva
programme.desc: Eva has been in charge of her younger sisters ever since their parents died, many years ago. Eva's uncanny ability to interfere in her sisters' affairs has not endeared her to their spouses and partners. The men would like to close out and divide up the family trust fund that Eva oversees. So they concoct a simple plan: compensate cash strapped ladies' man Ray Adams (LL Cool J) to romance and distract Eva from her familial duties. Sparks fly between Ray and Eva ... but the plan goes awry.

programme.title: Love Happens
programme.desc: Dr. Burke Ryan (Aaron Eckhart) is a self-help guru who is on the verge of a lucrative multimedia deal. But there's a problem: though he advises his patients to confront their pain, Burke has never come to terms with his wife's death. Eloise Chandler (Jennifer Aniston) has had enough of men and dating, and is busy concentrating on her floral business. When they meet, Burke and Eloise feel an instant attraction, but wonder if they'll be able to let go of their painful pasts and embrace the future.

programme.title: The Break-Up
programme.desc: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

programme.title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
programme.desc: Struggling musician Peter Bretter is better-known as the boyfriend of TV star Sarah Marshall. After she unceremoniously dumps him, he feels lost and alone but makes a last-ditch bid to get over it by going to Hawaii. However, she and her new boyfriend are there in the same hotel.

programme.title: The Five-Year Engagement
programme.desc: On their one-year anniversary, sous chef Tom Solomon (Jason Segel) plans to surprise his girlfriend, Violet Barnes (Emily Blunt), with an engagement ring. The lovers do end up engaged, but the fact that the proposal does not go exactly as planned proves to be a harbinger of things to come. Each time they try to set a date, various obstacles stand in their way. As more and more time passes, Tom and Violet begin to wonder if perhaps their marriage is not meant to be.

programme.desc: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Imperium
programme.desc: An idealistic FBI agent goes undercover to infiltrate a white supremacist group that's plotting an act of terror.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. Though alone and haunted by grief, Luke springs into action to save a Chinese girl (Catherine Chan) from the same gangsters who killed his family -- and lands in the middle of a high-stakes war. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play and it's all or nothing.

programme.title: One Day as a Lion
programme.desc: Jackie Powers is a nice guy but a lousy hit man who takes a waitress hostage after a job goes bad. When Jackie reveals he needs money to get his son out of jail, she cooks up a scheme for them to get cash from her dying mother.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: CIA operative James Silva leads a small but lethal paramilitary team on an urgent and dangerous mission. They must transport a foreign intelligence asset from an American embassy in Southeast Asia to an airfield for extraction -- a distance of 22 miles. Silva and the soldiers soon find themselves in a race against time as the city's military, police and street gangs close in to reclaim the asset.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: Barney & Friends
programme.desc: It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating. Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain. The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.

programme.title: Barney & Friends

In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison
